NORTHERN PLAINS SEED CERTIFICATION AND PURITY STANDARD

Section 1: General Requirements
All certified seed lots are tested by an accredited seed testing laboratory before a certificate of analysis is issued. Off-types are recorded during field inspection, and any lot exceeding its permitted off-type tolerance is downgraded to the next lower certification class. Isolation distances are measured as the minimum separation between a certified seed field and any field of a different or unapproved variety of the same species, to prevent cross-pollination.

Section 2: Certified Spring Wheat Seed Lot SW-114
Certified Spring Wheat Seed Lot SW-114 achieved a germination rate of 96.0 percent when tested at certification. After 12 months of storage, Certified Spring Wheat Seed Lot SW-114 was retested and achieved a germination rate of 91.5 percent. The purity percentage of Certified Spring Wheat Seed Lot SW-114 was determined to be 99.2 percent. Other-crop seed content in Certified Spring Wheat Seed Lot SW-114 was measured at 3 seeds per kilogram. The moisture content of Certified Spring Wheat Seed Lot SW-114 was 12.5 percent at the time of bagging. The thousand-kernel weight of Certified Spring Wheat Seed Lot SW-114 was 38.4 grams. The tolerance for off-types in Certified Spring Wheat Seed Lot SW-114 is set at 1 in 3,000 plants. The isolation distance required for Certified Spring Wheat Seed Lot SW-114 is 3 metres from any other spring wheat variety.

Section 3: Certified Barley Seed Lot BC-207
Certified Barley Seed Lot BC-207 achieved a germination rate of 94.5 percent. The purity percentage of Certified Barley Seed Lot BC-207 was determined to be 98.7 percent. The tolerance for off-types in Certified Barley Seed Lot BC-207 is set at 1 in 2,000 plants.

Section 4: Foundation Canola Seed Lot CN-330
Foundation Canola Seed Lot CN-330 achieved a germination rate of 92.0 percent. The isolation distance required for Foundation Canola Seed Lot CN-330 is 400 meters from any other canola variety.

Section 5: Registered Oat Seed Lot OT-88
The purity percentage of Registered Oat Seed Lot OT-88 was determined to be 97.5 percent.

Section 6: Certified Timothy Grass Seed Lot TG-45
Certified Timothy Grass Seed Lot TG-45 is classified as Certified seed.
